generator_cmd: printf %s 'Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, submit this' | basenc --base64url -w0 | tr -d =  # UTF-8 impostor, no NUL rhythm
oracle_cmd: s="$encoded"; while [ $(( ${#s} % 4 )) -ne 0 ]; do s="$s="; done; printf %s "$s" | basenc --base64url -d | od -An -tx1 | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -c '^00$'  # 0 NUL bytes -> not UTF-16 -> none
